CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_decision_log (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  thesis_request_id INT NOT NULL,
  decision_type ENUM('enrollment_eligibility', 'defense_eligibility') NOT NULL,
  decision ENUM('approved', 'rejected', 'blocked') NOT NULL,
  note VARCHAR(512) NULL,
  decided_by INT NOT NULL,
  decided_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_adl_request (thesis_request_id),
  INDEX idx_adl_decided_by (decided_by)
);
